text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The 'Overlord of the End of the Century 
Birth Drama' reaches its final act. 
Entering Chapter 3—!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Through this training camp, I will be 
reborn. Breaking through relentless 
marking to claim an overwhelming 
victory... as the BRAND NEW Supreme 
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And so, to be granted strength... I 
awaited the arrival of Poseidon, God of 
the Sea—!
